introduction: The `afspec_go_mutation_lint` module extends the Go `afspec` library with collection mutation functions for all spec entity types, sequential ID generation helpers, a lint module for spec validation and reporting, and a `LoadDependentInterfaces` helper for cross-spec context loading.

glossary.BuildDependencyGraph: Existing afspec function that constructs a dependency graph from a list of SpecMeta entries.
glossary.CorrectnessProperty: A correctness invariant entry within a RequirementsV1Json.
glossary.Criterion: A single acceptance criterion or edge case entry within a Requirement.
glossary.DependencyGraph: Graph struct returned by BuildDependencyGraph representing inter-spec dependencies.
glossary.DiscoverLintSpecs: The function that scans a specs directory and returns LintSpecInfo entries for folders containing requirements.json.
glossary.DiscoverSpecs: Existing afspec function that scans a root directory and returns SpecMeta entries for all discovered specs.
glossary.EdgeCaseTest: An edge case test entry within a TestSpecV1Json.
glossary.ErrorHandlingEntry: An error handling mapping entry within a RequirementsV1Json.
glossary.ExecutionPath: An execution path entry within a RequirementsV1Json.
glossary.LintFinding: A single lint diagnostic result with severity, rule, message, and location metadata.
glossary.LintResult: The aggregate output of a lint run, containing all findings and an exit code.
glossary.LintSpecInfo: Metadata about a discovered spec folder eligible for linting.
glossary.LoadDependentInterfaces: The function that loads interface summaries from upstream dependency specs for cross-spec context.
glossary.LoadSpec: Existing afspec function that loads a spec from a directory path into a Spec struct.
glossary.ParseSpecDirName: Existing afspec function that parses a spec directory name into its numeric prefix, spec name, and a validity boolean.
glossary.PropertyTest: A property-based test entry within a TestSpecV1Json.
glossary.Requirement: A single requirement entry within a RequirementsV1Json, identified by a unique ID.
glossary.RequirementsV1Json: The Go struct representing the top-level requirements artifact (requirements.json) in the afspec format.
glossary.SmokeTest: A smoke test entry within a TestSpecV1Json.
glossary.SpecMeta: Metadata struct returned by DiscoverSpecs describing a discovered spec's ID, name, and path.
glossary.Subtask: A single task item within a TaskGroup.
glossary.SubtaskState: The lifecycle state of a subtask (e.g. todo, in_progress, done, dropped).
glossary.TaskDependency: A dependency declaration between specs within a TasksV1Json.
glossary.TaskGroup: A group of subtasks within a TasksV1Json.
glossary.TasksV1Json: The Go struct representing the top-level tasks artifact (tasks.json) in the afspec format.
glossary.TestCase: A standard test case entry within a TestSpecV1Json.
glossary.TestSpecV1Json: The Go struct representing the top-level test specification artifact (test_spec.json) in the afspec format.
glossary.TraceabilityEntry: A traceability mapping between a requirement ID and a test spec ID within a TasksV1Json.
glossary.Validate: Existing afspec method on Spec that runs all validation rules and returns a ValidationResult.
glossary.ValidationResult: The struct returned by Validate containing a list of ValidationEntry findings.
glossary.filterSpec: An optional spec name string passed to DiscoverLintSpecs to restrict linting to a single named spec.
glossary.immutable-copy pattern: The convention in afspec where mutation functions return a new struct with the change applied and never modify the input in place.
glossary.lintAll: A boolean flag passed to RunLintSpecs; when false, fully-implemented specs (all subtasks done or dropped) are skipped.
glossary.spec_id: The numeric string prefix identifying a spec (e.g. '05'), used as a namespace in all entity IDs.
glossary.specsDir: The root directory path that contains numbered spec subdirectories (e.g. 01-my_spec/).

correctness_properties.title: Immutability of mutation inputs
correctness_properties.for_any: any mutation function in the afspec mutation package called with an input struct and any item
correctness_properties.invariant: the input struct passed to the mutation function is byte-for-byte identical after the call returns, regardless of whether the call succeeds or returns an error

correctness_properties.title: Duplicate ID rejection
correctness_properties.for_any: any Add* mutation function called twice with items sharing the same ID
correctness_properties.invariant: the second call always returns a non-nil error and the returned collection is identical to the input collection

correctness_properties.title: Next ID monotonicity
correctness_properties.for_any: any Next*ID function called on a collection, then the returned ID is used to add an item, then Next*ID is called again on the resulting collection
correctness_properties.invariant: the second call returns an ID with a strictly greater numeric suffix than the first call

correctness_properties.title: Next ID on empty collection returns suffix 1
correctness_properties.for_any: any Next*ID function called on an empty collection
correctness_properties.invariant: the returned ID always has numeric suffix 1

correctness_properties.title: SortFindings determinism
correctness_properties.for_any: any permutation of the same set of LintFinding values passed to SortFindings
correctness_properties.invariant: the returned slice is always identical regardless of the input ordering

correctness_properties.title: ComputeExitCode correctness
correctness_properties.for_any: any slice of LintFinding values passed to ComputeExitCode
correctness_properties.invariant: the return value is 1 if and only if at least one finding has Severity equal to 'error', and 0 otherwise

correctness_properties.title: LoadDependentInterfaces graceful degradation
correctness_properties.for_any: any call to LoadDependentInterfaces regardless of whether upstream specs exist or are loadable
correctness_properties.invariant: the function never returns an error and never panics; it always returns a slice (possibly empty)

steps.action: calls NextRequirementID with a RequirementsV1Json to obtain the next available requirement ID
scans existing requirement IDs using a compiled regex, computes max+1, and returns the formatted ID string
constructs a Requirement struct using the returned ID and calls AddRequirement
checks for duplicate ID, deep-copies the RequirementsV1Json, appends the new Requirement, and returns the new copy with nil error
receives the updated RequirementsV1Json and serializes it to requirements.json
parses the 'lint' subcommand arguments including specsDir and lintAll flag, then calls RunLintSpecs
calls DiscoverLintSpecs to enumerate spec folders containing requirements.json
for each discovered spec, calls LoadSpec to load the spec from disk
calls Validate on each loaded Spec to obtain a ValidationResult
converts ValidationResult entries to LintFinding structs, skipping fully-implemented specs when lintAll is false
calls SortFindings to order all collected findings, then calls ComputeExitCode
returns LintResult with sorted Findings and ExitCode to the CLI
prints each finding to stdout and calls os.Exit with the ExitCode

execution_paths.title: Cross-spec interface loading for artifact generation

steps.action: calls LoadDependentInterfaces with the current specID and specRoot
calls DiscoverSpecs to enumerate all specs under specRoot
calls BuildDependencyGraph with the discovered SpecMeta slice and specRoot to resolve upstream dependencies
for each upstream dependency, calls LoadSpec to load the upstream spec
extracts glossary entries, external API symbols, and criterion return contracts from each loaded spec into a map[string]any
returns the slice of interface maps to the caller; returns an empty slice if any step fails

error_handling.condition: AddRequirement, AddCorrectnessProperty, AddExecutionPath, or AddErrorHandling is called with a duplicate ID
error_handling.behavior: return the original RequirementsV1Json unchanged and a non-nil error whose message contains the duplicate ID string

error_handling.condition: AddCriterion or AddEdgeCase is called with a duplicate ID
error_handling.behavior: return the original Requirement unchanged and a non-nil error whose message contains the duplicate ID string

error_handling.condition: any Add* function for TestSpecV1Json is called with a duplicate ID
error_handling.behavior: return the original TestSpecV1Json unchanged and a non-nil error whose message contains the duplicate ID string

error_handling.condition: AddTaskGroup or AddSubtask is called with a duplicate ID
error_handling.behavior: return the original TasksV1Json or TaskGroup unchanged and a non-nil error whose message contains the duplicate ID string

error_handling.condition: AddTraceabilityEntry is called with a duplicate (requirement_id, test_spec_id) pair
error_handling.behavior: return the original TasksV1Json unchanged and a non-nil error whose message contains both the requirement_id and test_spec_id of the duplicate pair

error_handling.condition: DiscoverLintSpecs is called with a specsDir that does not exist or is not a directory
error_handling.behavior: return nil and a descriptive error; do not panic

error_handling.condition: DiscoverLintSpecs is called with a filterSpec that matches no discovered spec
error_handling.behavior: return nil and an error indicating no spec with that name was found

error_handling.condition: LoadSpec fails for a specific spec during RunLintSpecs
error_handling.behavior: record a LintFinding with Severity 'error' and Rule 'load-failure' for that spec and continue processing remaining specs without returning an error

error_handling.condition: DiscoverSpecs or BuildDependencyGraph returns an error inside LoadDependentInterfaces
error_handling.behavior: log the error internally and return an empty slice; do not propagate the error to the caller

error_handling.condition: a regex match finds no numeric suffix in an ID during Next*ID computation
error_handling.behavior: skip that ID when computing the maximum; do not panic or return an error

symbols.name: LoadSpec
symbols.notes: Loads a spec from a directory path into a Spec struct.

symbols.name: Validate
symbols.notes: Runs all validation rules on the loaded Spec and returns a ValidationResult.

symbols.name: ParseSpecDirName
symbols.notes: Returns the numeric prefix, spec name, and a validity boolean for a spec directory name.

symbols.name: IsSpecDirName
symbols.notes: Returns true if the given directory name matches the spec directory naming convention.

symbols.name: TransitionSubtask
symbols.notes: Existing mutation pattern — returns a new TasksV1Json with the subtask state updated.

symbols.name: CompleteSubtaskStates
symbols.notes: Existing mutation pattern — returns a new TasksV1Json with specified groups' subtasks marked complete.

symbols.name: BuildDependencyGraph
symbols.notes: Constructs a dependency graph from a list of SpecMeta entries; used by LoadDependentInterfaces.

symbols.name: DiscoverSpecs
symbols.notes: Scans a root directory and returns SpecMeta entries for all discovered specs.
